blocks.orig: The Manyara Best View Lodge & Spa is an astonishing lodge in one of Tanzania’s most beautiful locations, surrounded by lush nature and an abundance of tropical birds and other wildlife. Here, you are welcomed in luxuriously appointed rooms, comfortably furnished with fluffy kingsize beds, a beautiful bathroom with an outside shower and bathtub, and a private veranda that allows you to relax in complete privacy and take in the unique view. If you want to indulge even more, you can book a wonderful massage at the luxury in-house spa (or in your room if you want!), that offers all kinds of the most relaxing treatments – easily paid by card, as the lodge is fully cashless.
blocks.html: The Manyara Best View Lodge & Spa is a remarkable lodge set in one of the loveliest spots in Tanzania, with green nature all around and plenty of tropical birds and other wildlife. Its luxuriously appointed rooms await you, comfortably furnished with soft kingsize beds, a beautiful bathroom with a bathtub and an outdoor shower, and a private veranda where you can unwind undisturbed and enjoy the unique view. Would you like to treat yourself even more? Book a lovely massage at the luxury spa in the lodge (or in your own room if you prefer!), which offers a wide range of relaxing treatments – and you simply pay by card, because the lodge is completely cashless.

blocks.orig: Then imagine a sunset, sitting on your veranda on a 350-meter high top of the famous Rift Valley Escarpment with your aperitive in hand, overlooking the lodge’s infinity pool, and enjoying the vast views… See the magnificent escarpment wall on the left curving slightly forward and leading up to Lake Natron, and the glittering Lake Manyara in all her glory on the right. At the bottom of the escarpment, you find a lot of banana farms (which you can visit), and in the distance the vast Mbuyuni hillsides are visible, and behind those the Manyara Ranch (a significant wildlife migration zone). In short, this is the perfect place to relax in complete luxury with the most exquisite views you can imagine. Come and enjoy the moment in the Manyara Best View Lodge!
blocks.html: Now picture a sunset from your veranda, high on a 350-meter top of the well-known Rift Valley Escarpment, aperitive in hand, looking out over the lodge’s infinity pool and the wide views… To the left, the impressive escarpment wall bends gently forward towards Lake Natron, while to the right Lake Manyara sparkles in full glory. Below the escarpment lie many banana farms (which you are welcome to visit), further away you can see the wide Mbuyuni hillsides, and beyond them the Manyara Ranch (an important wildlife migration zone). Put simply, this is an ideal place to relax in total luxury with truly exquisite views. Come and savour the moment at the Manyara Best View Lodge!
